overview_description.description: DeChat is a decentralized communication platform that provides messaging and social features using blockchain technology. It allows users to send messages, manage digital identities, and interact within Web3 environments. The platform supports communication tools designed for blockchain users and communities, combining chat functions with decentralized applications and digital asset-related features.
